responsibility: Primary declaration header for Ada-specific extensions to GCC tree nodes. It defines the Ada lang_type/lang_decl payloads, macros for accessing GNAT-specific flags and cached fields on types, decls, references, and statements, accessors for custom Ada tree codes from ada-tree.def, and local builtin-code remappings, thereby giving the rest of gigi a shared ABI for representing Ada semantics inside GCC trees.
same_name_distinction: Declares how Ada-specific tree nodes and ordinary GCC nodes are represented and accessed in C code: lang_type/lang_decl payload structs, flag and field macros, statement operand accessors, and uses of codes from ada-tree.def. Unlike ada-tree.def, it does not define the set of Ada tree codes; it provides the ABI/access layer for working with those codes and attached Ada metadata.
